text:
Morgan: quick async check — API2 migration stitch. Posting a short status + owners list so folks can pick up any loose ends. TL;DR: canary tomorrow 09:00 PT, SDK flag publish by EOD, deprecation email draft in review.

Devin: noted. can you call out blockers?

Morgan: main blockers: 1) telemetry header change still behind infra review (Alvaro) 2) SDK break in python streaming client when header absent (Tara / sdk team) 3) docs + migration guide missing the auth nuance.

Alvaro: telemetry PR is in review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/412 — awaiting infra-chair ok for header rename `x-ri-client` -> `x-rw-client`. I asked for a brief impact assessment. ETA today noon PT.

Tara: SDK streaming fix is small, I pushed a patch to branch `api2-compat-stream-fix` but blocked by CI flake. sdk-ci reported a flaky test: `tests/stream/test_chunking.py::test_order`. I'm rerunning. If green I'll open a release PR for a patch release.

Katie: I can take docs: will add an "Auth header compatibility" section + short migration snippet. Rough markdown will be ready by 17:00 PT.

Morgan: nice. owners summary for tomorrow's canary:
- canary lead: Devin
- infra / telemetry: Alvaro
- SDK follow-up & release: Tara
- docs + user comms: Katie
- oncall escalation: @deploy-bot (runbook: `docs/runbooks/api2-canary.md`)

Devin: deploy plan: start canary with 5% traffic to staging-first slot, monitor token-level latency and error-rate for 30m. Rollforward if error-rate < 0.2% and p50 latency within 15% of baseline. Rollback on any 5xx spike > 1% sustained for 5m.

Morgan: add small QA smoke list (short):
- basic text generation using `client.generate()` with streaming and non-streaming flows
- embeddings endpoint parity for input batching 1..8
- auth header fallbacks (no header vs old name)
- SDK sample snippet in python and js run without exceptions

Tara: CI rerun green. I'll open release PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1290 — will tag `v1.12.3-api2patch`. ETA release in 2 hours.

Alvaro: infra approved header rename for canary path only (feature flagged). I'll coordinate rollout with Devin.

Morgan: communications: I've drafted a short email to customers explaining the API2 deprecation window and migration doc link. Putting it into #marketing for review after docs update. Also will seed a short note in support playbook.

deploy-bot: Canary slot `canary-2026-03-18-09` created. Monitor hooks configured: `metrics/api2-canary`, `logs/streaming-errors`.

Devin: quick ask — can SDK team add `api2_compat=true` flag as env var for the canary host so we can validate both SDK and raw HTTP callers?

Tara: done. env var added to canary host config. Also added a short test for `API2_COMPAT` presence.

Morgan: outstanding items (actionable):
- Alvaro: final infra sign-off on header rename and canary feature flag (ETA noon)
- Tara: open release PR + publish patch (in flight)
- Katie: docs section + migration snippet (ETA 17:00 PT)
- Devin: run canary tomorrow and call roll decision in thread
- Morgan: finalize customer email after docs approval

Devin: I'll run the canary and post a short readout (pass/fail + metrics) in this thread. If anything urgent pop @devin. :eyes:

Morgan: thanks everyone — if no major blockers we'll proceed with the canary tomorrow. If anything slips, flag immediately in this thread.

Tara: small note — I've added a short troubleshooting snippet to the SDK PR for users who see missing header errors:
```
# python example fallback
client_secret = os.getenv('API2_COMPAT') or os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY')
# prefer new header but fall back to old key for 48h window
```

Morgan: perfect. closing loop — I'll post an updated checklist tomorrow morning with final canary slot and monitoring links. :white_check_mark:
